history.summary: Belatgiri is a Shiva temple on a rocky hill in Satna district, Madhya Pradesh, reached by an easy-to-moderate trek (Tusk Travel). IDENTITY/LOCATION UNCERTAIN: no source names the exact hill or village; the founding dynasty and date are undocumented. A generic 'Temple' map listing at 24.575017, 80.830582 near Satna is not named Belatgiri and is NOT treated as this temple. Coordinates are approximate to Satna town. No verified photograph of the actual temple was found after image searching; media left empty rather than risking a wrong image.

name: Belatgiri Temple
town_description: Satna is a district headquarters city in the Vindhya region of Madhya Pradesh, a major cement-producing centre and railway junction on the Howrah-Mumbai line. It is the gateway to the Maihar (Maa Sharada) Shaktipeeth and the Chitrakoot pilgrim region.

travel.airport: Satna airstrip (limited services); nearest major airport Jabalpur ~200 km (verify).
travel.railway: Satna Junction - major railhead on the Howrah-Mumbai line (distance from the hilltop temple unknown, verify).
travel.road: Reached by road into Satna district, then an easy-to-moderate trek up the rocky hill to the temple (Tusk Travel).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March (verify - hill trek best avoided in monsoon).
